checklist.item: Threshold height and bevels meet the accessibility limit of the code in force (1/2 in / 13 mm maximum in most cases).
checklist.why: The most-measured dimension at final inspection.

checklist.item: A sill pan with back dam and end dams is under the threshold, lapped to the wall's water barrier.
checklist.why: Doors leak at the sill corners like windows do.

checklist.item: The exterior landing is lower than or slopes away from the threshold, within the allowed slope.
checklist.why: Water standing against the sill gets in.

checklist.item: Threshold is set in sealant, with weatherstripping and door bottom shown.
checklist.why: Air and water control at the door.

checklist.item: Thermal break in the threshold lines up with the slab-edge insulation.
checklist.why: A metal threshold on the slab is a cold strip.

checklist.item: Floor finish thickness each side is shown so the level change is real.
checklist.why: Finish changes move the threshold height.
